# Spine test fixtures

The JSON and binary fixtures in this directory come from the official
`EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes` repository at commit
`acc9e127d4590f65dacb0ef9bc711dc14de9d91a`.

They are used only for local browser verification and are excluded from the
npm production bundle. Their use is governed by
